snippet.title: My Hero Academia: All’s Justice - Nana Shimura DLC Character Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/my-hero-academia-alls-justice/

Evil will never win the day – I guarantee it.
A Hero from the past and former wielder of One For All - Nana Shimura - comes to MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice!

MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice is available now PlayStation 5!

Get it here: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/my-hero-academia-alls-justice/

The MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Season Pass – including 5 additional playable characters to be released post-launch.

The Ultimate Edition includes the base game, the Season Pass, 20 additional costumes, and 7 HUD banners.

#ps5 #ps5games #MHA #MHAAJ
